DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 訓練の案内をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the drill information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。集合場所と避難所の二つが書いてあり、どちらへ行くのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合場所と避難所の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It lists both an assembly point and an evacuation shelter, and I don't know which one to go to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the assembly point and the evacuation shelter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の訓練に参加される予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you planning to take part in this drill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。実際の災害の指示ではなく、この訓練日の順番を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訓練日の順番を確認したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to know the sequence for this drill day, rather than instructions for an actual disaster.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to confirm the sequence on the drill day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内担当へ、最初の集合先を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can ask the information staff where you should assemble first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。集合場所へ行けば、そのままずっと滞在すると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 集合後も滞在と思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I thought that once I went to the assembly point, I would stay there the whole time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your mistaken belief that you would remain there after assembling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族も参加しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will your family be taking part too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一緒に参加します。家族へ場所を教える前に、集合先とその後の移動を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族参加と連絡前の経路確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will take part together. Before telling my family where to go, I'll confirm the assembly point and where we move afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your family is participating and ask to confirm the route before contacting them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。分かった順番を図にメモし、訓練と災害時の案内を混ぜずに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図へ順番を記録し訓練と実災害を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll note the confirmed sequence on the map and explain it without mixing up the drill instructions with instructions for an actual disaster.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the sequence on the map and keep the drill and an actual disaster separate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。まず今回の訓練の集合先と移動順を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the person in charge. First, please confirm the assembly point and order of movement for this drill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の変更でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ日に二つ予約がありますが、変えたいのは皮膚科だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二予約の皮膚科だけ変更を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have two appointments on the same day, but I only want to change the dermatology appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to change only the dermatology appointment out of your two appointments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もう一つの診療科はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which department is your other appointment with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 眼科です。眼科の時間には来られるので、その予約は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 眼科を残す理由と希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ophthalmology. I can come at the ophthalmology appointment time, so please keep that appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to keep the ophthalmology appointment and ask to retain it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the two appointment numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。名前と日付が同じでも、二件全部を変更するのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二番号を示し全件変更を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. Even though the name and date are the same, I am not asking to change both appointments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show both numbers and make clear that you do not want both appointments changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 皮膚科の希望日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a preferred date for dermatology?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 翌週なら来られます。空きがあるか確認してから、元の皮膚科予約を変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌週の空き確認後の変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can come the following week. I'd like to change my original dermatology appointment after checking whether a slot is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to change it after checking availability for the following week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。変更後の皮膚科と、残した眼科の両方を、最後に読み上げてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更分と維持分を別々に復唱確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. At the end, could you read back both the changed dermatology appointment and the ophthalmology appointment that is being kept?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for separate readbacks of the changed appointment and the one being retained. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二件を分けて担当へ伝えます。変更できた日時と残る予約を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain the two appointments separately to the person in charge. We'll confirm the new date and time and the appointment that remains before letting you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought something you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、財布です。海岸で拾いましたが、今は水が上がって、同じ場所を指しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海岸拾得と水際変化で位置が示しにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, a wallet. I found it on the beach, but the water has risen now, so it is hard to point out the same spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it on the beach and that the changed waterline makes the location hard to show. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know what time you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午前九時です。今の水際ではなく、その時に歩いていた所を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見時刻と当時の位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At nine in the morning. I want to explain where I was walking then, rather than where the waterline is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the time of discovery and the location at that time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 固定した目印はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段から左へ少し歩いた所です。地図に印を付け、潮の位置だけで示さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段と地図の固定目印で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was a short walk to the left from the steps. I will mark it on a map so that I am not indicating it only by the tide line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the location using the steps and a map as fixed references. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 落とした人を調べようと開けてはいません。外側の砂はそのままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封と外側状態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not opened it to try to identify the person who lost it. The sand on the outside is still as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that it is unopened and describe its exterior condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発見状況と物を担当へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand the item over to the person in charge and explain how you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。時刻と階段からの位置を伝え、今の海岸の様子とは分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時状況と現在景色を区別して届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will give the time and the location relative to the steps, distinguishing those details from how the beach looks now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand it in while distinguishing the circumstances when you found it from the current scene. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 財布をお預かりします。地図の印と時刻を記録して担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take the wallet. I will record the mark on the map and the time, and pass them on to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受け取った箱の角が破れています。中身はまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取箱の破れと中身未確認を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The corner of the box I received is torn. I have not looked at the contents yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the tear in the box you received and that you have not checked its contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達の番号は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the delivery number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。箱の全体と破れた所を写真に撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号と全体破損部写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the number. I took photos of the whole box and the torn area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the number and photos of the whole box and the damaged part. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身も壊れているとは、まだ分からないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you do not yet know whether the contents are damaged too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。箱の破れだけを確認しました。中が壊れたと先に言わず、確認方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱損傷と中身損傷を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is right. I have only confirmed the tear in the box. I want to ask how to check, without first claiming that the contents are damaged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish damage to the box from damage to its contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開封と記録の進め方を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us ask the person in charge how to proceed with opening it and keeping a record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。箱を捨てたり、破れを自分で補修したりする前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱処分や補修前に確認手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will consult them before throwing the box away or repairing the tear myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the checking procedure before disposing of or repairing the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人へは連絡していますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。確認できた外箱の状態と番号を先に伝え、中身については調べてから追加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人へ確認済み状態から連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will first give the number and the outer-box condition I have confirmed, then add information about the contents after checking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Contact the sender starting with the condition you have confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号と写真をお持ちください。担当から確認手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the number and photos. The person in charge will explain the checking procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a transaction slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を払った証拠を求められました。このATMの紙でよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ATM紙が家賃支払証明になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was asked for proof that I paid my rent. I do not know whether this ATM slip will do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ATM slip can serve as proof of rent payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この明細は現金を引き出した記録です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This slip records a cash withdrawal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでした。引き出したお金を家賃に使ったつもりですが、振込の記録とは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引出しと振込記録を区別して理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Of course. I believe I used the cash I withdrew for rent, but that is different from a bank transfer record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the difference between a withdrawal record and a transfer record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の支払い方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check how you actually made the payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金を渡しました。銀行ではその受取まで確認できないと思うので、相手の領収書を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金払いで相手の領収書を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I handed over cash. I do not think the bank can confirm that the recipient received it, so I will look for their receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you paid cash and will look for the recipient’s receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 銀行の取引記録については案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide information about bank transaction records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。引出し日だけで、家賃の受取日を証明したと言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引出日と受取日を同一証明としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will be careful not to say that the withdrawal date alone proves the date the rent was received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not treat the withdrawal date and receipt date as the same proof. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録の内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the contents of the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。銀行記録と相手の受取記録を分け、提出先に必要な証拠を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行と相手記録を分け提出条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will keep the bank record separate from the recipient’s record and ask the organization requesting the documents what evidence it needs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the bank and recipient records and confirm the submission requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらは引出し明細です。家賃の受取については、支払先の記録をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is a withdrawal slip. Please check the payee’s records regarding receipt of the rent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help with something in the sales area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この冷凍品を取ったら、片側だけ柔らかいです。まだ買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入前冷凍品の片側が柔らかいと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I picked up this frozen item, I noticed that only one side was soft. I have not bought it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that one side of a frozen item is soft before purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの冷凍ケースから取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which freezer case did you take it from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の右側です。自分で別の場所へ戻すと状態が分からなくなるので、持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケース位置と自己返却を避けた理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one at the back on the right. I brought it here because putting it back somewhere else myself would make its condition harder to trace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where the case is and why you avoided putting the item back yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。ほかの商品も同じでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check it. Were the other items the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほかは触っていません。この一袋の状態だけを伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他商品は触れず一袋のみの観察と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not touched the others. I am only reporting the condition of this one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not touched other items and observed only this one bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一袋をお預かりします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。私は別の商品を選ぶ前に、売場の確認が終わるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当へ渡し別商品選択前に売場確認を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Before choosing a different item, I would like to ask whether the sales area check will be completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand it to the person in charge and ask about checking the sales area before choosing another item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will let you know after the person in charge checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では待ちます。柔らかい部分があるだけで、全部の食品が傷んでいると広めるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認を待ち売場全体の異常と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will wait. I will not spread a claim that all the food is spoiled just because part of this item is soft.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the check and will not conclude that the whole sales area has a problem. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この袋と取った場所を担当へ伝えます。確認後に売場をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge about this bag and where you took it from. We will direct you to the sales area after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示の二キロは、出口までの距離ですか。それとも一周分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二キロ表示が出口までか一周か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does the two-kilometer sign mean the distance to the exit, or the distance around the full circuit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the two-kilometer sign refers to the exit or a full circuit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図では一周の距離です。どのくらい歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map, it means the distance around the circuit. How far are you planning to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短く歩いて駅側へ出たいです。一周しないと出口へ行けないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短い散歩と駅出口の希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want a short walk and then to leave on the station side. I thought I had to go all the way around to reach the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a short walk and the station-side exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 駅側の出口へは、この分かれ道で外れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can leave the circuit at this fork to reach the station-side exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこへ行きたいです。一周分を歩く時間ではなく、出口までの道を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一周でなく出口への経路を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is where I want to go. I want to confirm the route to the exit, rather than how long it takes to walk the full circuit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the route to the exit rather than the full circuit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お連れの方も同じ出口ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the person with you using the same exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。疲れているので、長い方へ先に入らず、二人で短い道を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 疲れた同行者と短い道を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They are tired, so we will choose the short route together without heading onto the long route first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will choose the short route with your tired companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図の黄色い線をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the yellow line on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黄色い線ですね。分かれ道で出口表示を見てから進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 黄色線と分岐の出口表示を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The yellow line, right. I will check the exit sign at the fork before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat back the yellow line and the exit sign at the fork. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この線が駅側の出口です。距離の表示と出口の方向を分けてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: This line leads to the station-side exit. Please distinguish the distance marking from the direction of the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きいお荷物についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スキー板を袋に入れています。列車の入口に立てかけず、置ける場所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 板の置場を入口以外で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have skis in a bag. I would like to ask where I can put them without leaning them against the train entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about somewhere other than the entrance to store your skis. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご乗車の列車はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この時刻の列車です。空いた座席を荷物置きにしてよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車を示し空席を荷物置きと決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The train at this time. I am not assuming I can use an empty seat as a luggage space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify your train and say that you do not assume empty seats can be used for luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の長さと列車の設備を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the luggage length and the facilities on the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋に入れたままでこの長さです。先が通路に出ない場所が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋込み長さと通路にはみ出さない条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the length with the bag still on. I need somewhere where the tips will not stick out into the aisle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the length including the bag and the requirement that it not extend into the aisle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご同行の方はいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人です。置き場所へ運ぶ時も、周りに当てないよう一度止まって向きを変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人搬送で他人に当てない方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am alone. When carrying it to the storage place, I will also stop briefly to change its direction so that I do not hit anyone around me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you will carry it alone without hitting other people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車時に係へもご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also consult the attendant when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。場所が分からないまま入口へ置きっぱなしにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車係へ聞き入口へ放置しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not leave it at the entrance while still unsure where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the boarding attendant and will not leave it unattended at the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この列車の荷物の案内を確認します。乗車口の通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the luggage guidance for this train. Please wait while keeping the boarding entrance passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の手続きでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。新居へ入るまで数日ホテルにいます。今日の滞在先をそのまま住所に書くのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ホテル滞在中の届出住所を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am staying in a hotel for a few days before moving into my new home. I do not know whether to enter today’s place of stay as my address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which address to register while staying at a hotel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新居に住み始める日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you decided when you will start living in your new home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週の月曜です。鍵は受け取りましたが、まだ生活を始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入居予定と鍵受取後も未居住を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next Monday. I have received the keys, but I have not started living there yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your planned move-in date and that you have not lived there yet despite receiving the keys. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付と滞在状況を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the dates and your accommodation situation with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。鍵をもらった日、ホテルの宿泊日、住み始める日を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵受取宿泊居住開始の三日付を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will separately explain the day I received the keys, the days I stay at the hotel, and the day I start living there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the three dates: receiving the keys, hotel accommodation, and beginning residence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新居の住所資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have documents showing your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書があります。ホテルの予約票とは別に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約書と予約票を別提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the contract. I will present it separately from the hotel reservation slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the contract and reservation slip separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が手続きの準備をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to prepare for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日出せるかを説明で確かめ、日付を自分の都合で先に書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出可否を確認し日付を自己決定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will confirm from their explanation whether I can submit it today, and will not put down a date in advance just to suit myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm whether submission is possible and will not decide the date yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 契約書と予定日をお持ちください。滞在先と新居を分けて担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the contract and planned date. Explain your temporary accommodation and new home separately to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ちの間、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened while you were waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受付の時よりお腹の痛みが強くなりました。問診票を書いた時とは状態が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付後の腹痛増加を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My abdominal pain has become worse than it was at reception. My condition is different from when I filled in the medical questionnaire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report increased abdominal pain since reception. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ頃から強くなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: About when did it get worse?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分ほど前です。最初は時々痛みましたが、今は続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 増加時刻と間欠から持続への変化を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: About ten minutes ago. At first the pain came and went, but now it is continuous.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when it worsened and the change from intermittent to continuous pain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変化を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge about the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。順番があるからと黙って待たず、変わった状態を知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 順番待ちでも変化を知らせたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than waiting silently because there is a queue, I want to let you know that my condition has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to report the change even while waiting your turn. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに新しい症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any other new symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 吐き気も出ました。どちらも受付後からです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付後の新しい吐気を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have also developed nausea. Both started after reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the new nausea that began after reception. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が今の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check your current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。痛みが増えた時刻と吐き気を、もう一度説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二症状と発生時刻を再説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will explain again when the pain got worse and about the nausea.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the two symptoms and their onset times again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の変化を担当へ引き継ぎます。こちらでお待ちいただき、状態がまた変わればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on the current changes to the person in charge. Please wait here, and let us know if your condition changes again.
